title: How are these 3D house videos made

yell.text: I could watch these 3D house videos forever… and I have no idea how they're made.

calm: It's way simpler than it looks. Watch.

clip.says: But the mud only smears around, so you build an arch with soap and cloth strips.

steps.text: Step one: open Zyvo, pick Cutaway Explainer.
Step two: type a topic, or tap a ready one.
Step three: it writes, voices and builds the 3D scene.

end.text: It's called Zyvo. Link in bio. Save this for your first video.

caption: I could watch these 3D house videos forever 🏠 How to make 3D cutaway videos in 3 steps. Save this for your first video. #3danimation #explainer #aivideo #fyp
claims: The clip and the step-three frames are the owner's own Cutaway Explainer creation "How a Car Wash Works" (f32e2f20), 2.45-6.55 s; step two is its real topic screen. No number is claimed.
